text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When Yaeno Muteki headed to practice, she 
saw Mejiro Ardan favoring her aching leg. 
Without hesitation, Yaeno Muteki rushed 
over to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And she learned that Mejiro Ardan was 
risking her very life to take on the 
Japanese Derby—seeking to carve proof of 
her existence with victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Sakura Chiyono O's training was 
also growing increasingly grueling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shouldering the hopes of Maruzensky, whom 
she deeply admires, she holds an 
extraordinary determination to achieve 
absolute victory at the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the resolve of her two generation 
rivals, Yaeno Muteki renewed her 
determination to challenge them with all 
her heart and soul.
